notes.title: DDS (D.I.Y. Drone Simulator) Demo - Removal
notes.content:
Hello Everybody,

We would like to announce that this product, the "DDS (D.I.Y. Drone Simulator) Demo" will be taken down from Steam.

The biggest reason for this is that this product does not reflect the current version of our Drone Simulator, which you can find here https://steamcommunity.com/app/876170/.

We are constantly working hard in order to update and upgrade this game. If you have any inquiries about this, please let us know.

Sincerely,

The D.I.Y. Drone Simulator Team
